title.value: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Specific Microscopy Threshold

description.value: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Microscopy: Specific microscopy — ordinal threshold presence by microscopy or staining technique', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Object sought and stain named in the code, result is the detection (LOINC PrThr + Ord + stain). Host cells (leukocytes, erythrocytes, epithelia) are included because the technique, not a class, selects. Parts: LOINC enumeration (331, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include.
